{{Quote|Got more problems with animals -- mynocks, now. Not space mynocks, but the ground-bound Tatooine kind.|Pfilbee Jhorn|<ref name="SWG:PJ" />}}
'''Tatooine mynocks''' were a subspecies of [[Mynock/Legends|mynock]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. They were considered a pest and could be aggressive.<ref name="SWG:PJ" />

Around the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] was attacked by Tatooine mynocks in the deserts of Tatooine.<ref name="SSW">''[[Super Star Wars]]''</ref> Later, the [[Human]] [[Pfilbee Jhorn]] commissioned an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]]-aligned [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to [[Death/Legends|eradicate]] the pests near [[Bestine (city)/Legends|Bestine]]. In return, he rewarded the spacer with a number of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="SWG:PJ" /> Around the same time, [[W. Wald]] also hired spacers to deal with large Tatooine mynocks eating power cables in [[Watto/Legends|Watto]]'s [[Wald's Parts|junkyard]] in [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]].<ref name="SWG:WW">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Wald's Woes|Tatooine}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Tatooine mynocks appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:PJ" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
